Camp. near Palmereth. Va_
Hood. querters Sent, Sturges (9rd) ſinnen
Dee. 8th 1862. "

Iz Brown- & Co.

Dear friends
Mr. Wells

return to morrow, and I improre the of
- pirtiendly to send a line by him lo to you.
not feeling quite certain if posted matter
reaches dieetly when sent from the Army.
We reached Aquia Creek safely in
the time anticipated, and to my great joy
learned immediately that our old friend
Capt (maj:) Had (of the 21th was 2. Master
as soon as the Boat was unloaded he came
on board and spent the remainder of the evening
with me, we had a home chat I assure wre you
remaine till the next sent a bbl use of
apples ete up to the Capt's quarters, and
proceeded with the remainder of our luggage
for which, it is needless to say ready transportdien
